title.en: A palace above a funerary urn

alt.en: An olive-glazed urn supports tiers of seated figures, animals and tiled roofs against a dark background.
alt.zh: 橄榄绿釉陶罐上层叠着坐像、动物和瓦顶楼阁，背景深暗。

caption.en: Funerary urn (hunping), Western Jin dynasty; Yue ware, stoneware with olive-green glaze. The Metropolitan Museum of Art, 1992.165.21.
caption.zh: 魂瓶，西晋；越窑橄榄绿釉炻器。大都会艺术博物馆，1992.165.21。

interpretation.en: The museum identifies Buddhist figures alongside a model palace and auspicious animals, linking new imagery to existing afterlife beliefs. Its proposed use as a dwelling for the soul remains an interpretation.
interpretation.zh: 馆方识别出佛像、楼阁模型与瑞兽的组合，将新图像与既有来世信仰联系起来。将其用途解释为灵魂居所，仍属研究观点。

items.creator: Maker unrecorded
items.credit: Charlotte C. and John C. Weber Collection, Gift of Charlotte C. and John C. Weber, 1992

note.en: The exact museum item page labels the image Public Domain; the official API confirms isPublicDomain=true.
note.zh: 博物馆此单件页面将图像标为公共领域；官方API确认isPublicDomain=true。

title.en: Four lugs on a small green-glazed jar

alt.en: A squat, rounded jar has a short open neck, small shoulder loops and mottled green-brown glaze.
alt.zh: 矮圆罐有短颈敞口、肩部小系和斑驳的青褐色釉面。

caption.en: Jar with four lugs, 4th century; Yue-type stoneware with green glaze, height 7.3 cm. The Metropolitan Museum of Art, 1977.449.8.
caption.zh: 四系罐，四世纪；越窑式青釉炻器，高7.3厘米。大都会艺术博物馆，1977.449.8。

interpretation.en: The small vessel gives the period’s ceramic history a specific form and scale. The catalogue records no court owner or named workshop.
interpretation.zh: 这件小器物为此期陶瓷史提供具体形制与尺度。目录未记载宫廷物主或具名作坊。

note.en: The exact museum item page labels the image Public Domain; the official API confirms isPublicDomain=true.
note.zh: 博物馆此单件页面将图像标为公共领域；官方API确认isPublicDomain=true。

title.en: A long-necked jar attributed to Great Gaya

alt.en: A dark, round-bodied jar has a tall neck encircled by raised bands and textured horizontal strips.
alt.zh: 深色圆腹壶有高颈，颈部环绕凸起带纹与带有细密纹理的横条。

caption.en: Long-necked jar, third quarter of the 5th century, attributed to Great Gaya; stoneware with accidental ash glaze. The Metropolitan Museum of Art, 1997.34.4.
caption.zh: 长颈壶，五世纪第三个四分之一，归于大伽耶；带自然落灰釉的炻器。大都会艺术博物馆，1997.34.4。

interpretation.en: The museum’s Great Gaya attribution offers a more specific regional reference than a single label for the whole confederation. The catalogue does not identify an excavated tomb or owner.
interpretation.zh: 馆方归属大伽耶的判断，比涵盖整个联盟的单一标签提供更具体的区域参照。目录未指明出土墓葬或物主。

note.en: The exact museum item page labels the image Public Domain; the official API confirms isPublicDomain=true.
note.zh: 博物馆此单件页面将图像标为公共领域；官方API确认isPublicDomain=true。
